timing_semantics.summary_header: GitLab job duration wall, includes pre/post/possible resource wait; not active GPU collection hours
timing_semantics.multi_shard_seconds: run_collector elapsed wall inside already-running container, includes collect.py startup/warmup/forward/finalization and possible exit-grace watchdog; excludes container provisioning and communication
timing_semantics.single_shard_fallback_seconds: If artifact lacks shard directories, package_run substitutes GitLab job duration, not same clock as multi-shard seconds
timing_semantics.restore_dedup: package_run keeps DONE/later shard status and can union partial jobs, so final per-shard summaries do not retain all retry cost; raw jobs needed for spend accounting
timing_semantics.GPU_weight: Visible GPUs/device_count starts worker pool in collector. Need actual participating workers/communication ranks and exclude idle tails; allocation times not actual collection metric.

historical_campaign.timing_caveat: Retained status seconds mix latest collector invocations with fallback CI durations; resumes overwrite prior invocation clocks; actual per-attempt GPU participants differ. No valid GPU-hour total follows from summing them.

concrete_fallback_example.clock: GitLab job wall, not isolated collection

historical_readme_guideline.status: historical rule of thumb; GPU SKU, exact plan and measurement boundary not specified; not current baseline
